card.name: Verb just before "recommended" or "advised"
card.fires_on: The helping verb (is, are) or subject word right after a test, monitoring or exam phrase, where the next word is likely "recommended" or "advised".

modes.label: Is/are after monitoring item
modes.description: The verb follows a noun phrase naming a lab test or exam and is followed by recommended.
modes.example: Thyroid function tests<< are>> recommended where clinically indicated.

modes.label: We before recommend
modes.description: The subject "We" in general web text, leading into "highly recommend".
modes.example: The majority of this activity has voice audio.<< We>> highly recommend headphones in a classroom setting.

card.writes: Promotes recommend-type words (recommended, recommendation, suggestion) in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires when a sentence is about to say that a test or action is recommended.
